title: SignedContainmentAttestation
description:
The value of `JobStatus.containment_attestation`, carried as JSON text
(§5).

jws.description:
RFC 7515 compact serialization with a DETACHED payload:
`<b64url(header)>..<b64url(signature)>`. The header is exactly
`{"alg":"ES256","x5c":[leaf, intermediates…]}` (§4).

AppliedContainment.description:
What the executor OBSERVED it enforced for one run.

Executor-attested. A reader records it as attested by the executor, never
as verified by the reader.

profile_digest.description:
The digest of the profile the executor resolved. Must equal the
request's [`Containment::profile_digest`]; a difference means the
registry changed and the executor should have refused.

ContainmentAttestationPayload.description:
What blackwall-serve signs for one job (§3).

**Checked** by reflex: `typ`, `iat`, `action_id`, `run_custody_hash`,
`containment_sha256`, `applied`. **Signed but informational**:
`escapement_attempt` and `trace_id`, which reflex does not seal.

action_id.description:
The reflex action id, relayed verbatim from the task payload's
`action.id` (§6). Never copied from the escapement task id.

applied.description: What serve observed it enforced, by value.

containment_sha256.description:
[`crate::containment::Containment::sha256`] of the request serve
received, deserialized into `Containment` first — never a hash over
the received bytes (§3).

escapement_attempt.description:
escapement's 0-based attempt counter for this dispatch, verbatim from
`JobView.attempt`. Named for its source: `TaskResult.attempt` is a
different counter.

iat.description:
When serve signed, in unix seconds. The chain is validated as of this
instant (Q3b).

run_custody_hash.description:
blackwall's run hash for this job. reflex seals `run_ref` FROM this
signed value, which is the replay defence (§7).

trace_id.description:
The W3C trace id serve received: 32 lowercase hex. The trace id only;
the parent span is escapement's by construction and could never match
reflex's seal. `null` when the dispatch carried no `traceparent`
(the header is optional on the edge). The key is ALWAYS present, so
the signer and the verifier canonicalize the same key set (wX:p1's
ruling (a) on soma#495).

EnforcedLayer.description: One layer the executor observed in force.

evidence.description:
The observation BY VALUE: a compact JSON extract of what was read (a
jail probe result, the CiliumEndpoint policy status, the guest and
host kernel identities), carried as JSON text so it is byte-stable in
the record. Never a label, a stamp, or a reference to an object that
may be garbage-collected before anyone audits it. Empty is no evidence.

layer.description:
`"landlock"`, `"landlock-exec"`, `"kata"`, `"cnp"`, `"tetragon"` — an
open set; the requirement is whatever the profile's `required_layers`
names.
